Professional Summary

I am a Web Developer and Computer Science Lecturer based in Chattogram. My work centers on building structured, database-driven web applications and teaching fundamental software engineering principles to university and academy students.

Since 2022, I have taught courses ranging from structured programming in C++ and Python to software development and compiler design. Explaining complex architectures daily reinforces my focus on clean code, proper data modeling, and reliable application state.

Currently, I am pursuing my M.Sc in CSE at IIUC while building production-ready web platforms using PHP, Laravel, MySQL, and modern frontend tools.
